text: tests/contracts/windmill/llmkit.yaml (copy of the consumer contract from the windmill repo) listed LLMKIT_DATABASE_URL in static env and the run case fallback_to_second_model, which relied on llmkit's own chain fallback. LLMKIT-010 edited this copy: the env line and that case are gone, and tests/contracts/data/*.json lost their prices key, because routing v1 rejects prices. The windmill repo copy needs the same change by its own agent.

docs/adr/0003-odna-baza-zhurnala.md still decides that llmkit keeps one journal database of its own. LLMKIT-010 (and ADR-0001, epic E-003) removed the database entirely: llm cost reads the gateway journal read-only. The ADR stands unchanged; a superseding ADR may be needed so the decisions list does not contradict the code.
